title: INT-04 · Conflicts and humanitarian crisis in the news

blocks.text: INT-04 · Conflicts and humanitarian crisis in the news
Lesson overview

News about humanitarian crises is among the most read and hard to report: figures are estimates, sources are often involved, words have a legal weight (refugeed, displaced, famine, war crime) and a translation error can change the sense of a relationship. In this unit you learn the humanitarian vocabulary of the press and UN agencies (displacement, access, food security, appeals and funding), the Arab names of the main organizations, the precise distinction between refugee, internally displaced, asylum seeker and migrant, and the way to treat terms with legal or technical value, which are always attributed to those who are competent to use them. The vocabulary is that of public news and communications: no operational details. Two weeks.

rows: B2-06 (security and defence in the media); B2-08 → B2-12; INT-01 → INT-03
12–14 hours · two weeks (weeks 203–204), plus the ARZ/EGY track

blocks.text: Materials This unit, the news page in Arabic of the United Nations and the sites in Arabic of humanitarian agencies (Appendix C), session with the tutor
Targets. At the end of the lesson you know:
1. understanding news and communications about humanitarian crises: needs, access, aid, appeals, funding;
2. recognizing the Arab names of the main humanitarian organisations and their Italian acronyms;
3. to distinguish precisely refugees, displaced persons, asylum seekers, migrants and stateless persons;
4. To treat terms with technical or legal value with caution ( ⁧مَجَاعَة⁩ , ⁧جَرَائِمُ حَرْبٍ⁩ ...), assigning them;
5. report humanitarian figures with the source, type of data (estimate, registration, projection) and date.
Two-week plan.

blocks.text: In this class. The vocabulary serves to understand and translate public news and documents. The status of a real person is determined by the competent authorities in accordance with legal procedures: the translator makes the word used in the source exactly, without replacing it.
7. Terms with legal or technical value

rows: Who is competent to use it
courts and judicial bodies; for the accusations: who accuses
Who is competent to use it
international courts; for the accusations: who accuses

blocks.text: ⁧تَحْقِيقٌ⁩ · ⁧لَجْنَةُ تَقَصِّي الحَقَائِقِ⁩ Committee of Inquiry · Independent Investigation

The rule. These terms are always attributed and in the form used by the source: ⁧اِتَّهَمَتْ مُنَظَّمَةٌ حُقُوقِيَّةٌ⁩ … ⁧بِارْتِكَابِ⁩ « ⁧جَرَائِمِ حَرْبٍ⁩ "A human rights organization has accused... of "war crimes." They never become a qualification of the translator or analyst. If a court has issued a judgment or a technical body has made a formal declaration, it is precisely said: who, when, by what act.
